heading: INT. SUBWAY CAR - RUSH HOUR - STALLED

units.text: INT. SUBWAY CAR - RUSH HOUR - STALLED
A packed car.
The lights flicker, then the train JERKS to a stop between stations.
The announcement crackles and dies.
Nobody can move more than two inches.
FRANCESCA, 30, in a bridesmaid dress with a garment bag over one arm, is pinned against the door.
She holds her phone above her head, searching for a signal.
DEVIN, 32, in a rumpled suit, is wedged against her back, holding a cake box very carefully above his head.
Sorry. Sorry. Is that your elbow?
units.name: DEVIN

units.text: That is your cake.
units.name: FRANCESCA

units.text: It's a wedding cake. For a wedding.
units.name: DEVIN

units.text: Which wedding?
units.name: FRANCESCA

units.text: Mine. Well. My sister's. I'm best man.
units.name: DEVIN

units.text: She cranes around.
He blinks at her.
She has a streak of mascara under one eye, and a tiara crooked in her hair.
I'm the maid of honor. At the Whitfield wedding.
units.name: FRANCESCA

units.text: That's my sister.
units.name: DEVIN

units.text: Then you're the brother who never RSVPs.
units.name: FRANCESCA

units.text: He opens his mouth, closes it.
GUS, 60s, a retired conductor squeezed in beside them with a trombone case, chuckles.
BERNADETTE, 20s, in tights and a tutu, is crouched on the floor eating a bagel.
TARIQ, 18, headphones on, is asleep standing up, drooling against a pole.
You two should just get married.
units.name: GUS

units.text: FRANCESCA and DEVIN (together) No.
The train shudders.
Lights out.
Total darkness.
A collective groan.
Then the screen of her phone glows.
ON PHONE: Mom: "WHERE ARE YOU.
CEREMONY IN 20"
ON PHONE: Bride: "if the cake's not here by 3 I'm eloping"
Uh oh.
units.name: DEVIN

units.text: Oh no.
units.name: FRANCESCA

units.text: She turns to look at him in the blue glow.
The tiara has slipped almost over one eye.
He lowers the cake box an inch and, in the dark, breathes out.
This is the last time they will be strangers.
The emergency lights come on.
A dull thunk, and the train lurches forward.
Everybody tilts the same direction.
The cake box slides out of Devin's hands, Francesca catches it, Gus catches her, and Bernadette catches the bagel.
Did we make it?
units.name: TARIQ

units.text: No.
units.name: BERNADETTE

units.text: Cool.
units.name: TARIQ
